answer: Require each agent identity to anchor itself with a refundable stake that is slashed if fraud is proven, and let reputation grow only through verified completed work. An attacker must then pay stake plus time for every fake identity, so creating thousands of sybils becomes linearly expensive. A reputation bridge between services strengthens this: honest history travels with the agent, while a new fake must start again at the bottom, in the shale layer of unproven newcomers, with no trust to spend.
